messages:
alex: ran an overnight KV residency/profile run against long-ctx heavy nodes and found strong tenant skew + fragmentation causing sustained pagewalk churn.

jin: can you paste the top-level numbers?

alex: sample (30m window, node gpu-07b):
```
total_resident_pages: 1_200_000
tenant_main: 844_000 (70.3%)
tenant_midsize: 160_000 (13.3%)
tenant_small: 96_000 (8.0%)
others: 100_000 (8.4%)
pagewalks/sec baseline: 120 -> during eviction spikes: 640 (+433%)
avg page rehydrate latency: 12ms -> 30ms under compaction
```

maria: so heavy long-ctx tenant pins most pages. do we see refcounts never dropping (leak) or reuse pattern collapse?

alex: reuse counters drop post-evict, refcounts zero out, so not a leak. it's eviction+rehydrate thrash + fragmentation (hot prefixes split across pages). growth correlates with sessions > 24k tokens.

sam: sounds like noisy neighbor + global LRU misbehavior. current LRU happily lets heavy-access tenant keep majority. eviction thrash then kills locality for everyone.

jin: agreed. options: per-tenant soft watermarks, weighted eviction policy, tenant-aware LRU segments, or explicit pin lists for enterprise bots. also compaction tuning to avoid running during ingress peaks.

rachel: tradeoffs: fairness vs tail throughput. strict caps could drop throughput for paying tenant. prefer soft limits + burst windows + observability.

alex: prototyping these three primitives:
- soft_quota_pct (default 30%) with configurable burst window
- tenant_weighted_eviction: GC prefers evicting pages from tenants over quota
- prefix_pin API for enterprise (retain small set of prefixes pinned)

sam: i'll extend sim harness to drive mixed population: 50% shortctx (<=2k tokens), 30% medium (<=16k), 20% longctx (>=32k). will sweep soft_quota=[10,20,30,50], burst=[30s,2m,10m], compaction_pause=[true,false].

perf-bot: ci/perf/sim-longctx-iso triggered (id: run-2026-04-12-07)

alex: early sim: soft_quota=30%, burst=2m, compaction_pause=true -> top tenant residency fell to ~43%, pagewalk spikes down ~60%, 95p token latency returned to within 5% of baseline.

jin: great. what metrics should Console show to customers? I suggest per-tenant residency_pct, eviction_rate/s, and recent_rehydrates/min. plus alert when residency_pct > threshold for 5m.

maria: also show tenant tier (default vs enterprise override) and pin list status. add auto-email for infra owners when node_evictions/s > X.

rachel: rollout plan? canary 1 AZ, 5% traffic, monitor eviction_rate, tail-latency, and customer visible errors. abort criteria: sustained >10% tail regression or 10% increase in errors.

sam: action items:
- sam: add sim scenarios + dashboards (ETA 2d)
- alex: implement tenant_weighted_eviction + soft_quota enforcement prototype (ETA 5d)
- jin: design pin API and enterprise config knobs (ETA 3d)
- rachel: draft canary playbook and alert thresholds (ETA 2d)

alex: one micro-optimization we tested: prefix-coalescing during eviction (try to evict whole non-hot ranges rather than interleaved pages) reduced rehydrates by ~35% for our chat-bot traces. will add to PR.

maria: good. sync tomorrow 11am PT to review sim run outputs and PR diffs. please bring perf graphs.

sam: ack

jin: ack

rachel: ack :rocket:
